ud5.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
ud5.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī manussadaliddo ahosi
ud5.3:1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
ud5.3:2.1: addasā kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī mahājanakāyaṃ dūrato va sannipatitaṃ
ud5.3:2.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho ettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā bhājiyati
ud5.3:2.5: appeva nāmettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā labheyyanti.
ud5.3:3.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī yena so mahājanakāyo tenupasaṅkami.
ud5.3:3.2: addasā kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ
ud5.3:3.4: na kho ettha kiñci khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā bhājiyati
ud5.3:3.5: samaṇo ayaṃ gotamo parisati dhammaṃ deseti
ud5.3:4.1: atha kho bhagavā sabbāvantaṃ parisaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasākāsi
ud5.3:4.2: ko nu kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātunti.
ud5.3:4.3: addasā kho bhagavā suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinnaṃ
ud5.3:4.5: ayaṃ kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātunti.
ud5.3:4.6: suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ ārabbha anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
ud5.3:4.7: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
ud5.3:4.8: yadā bhagavā aññāsi suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
ud5.3:4.10: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya
ud5.3:4.11: evameva suppabuddhassa kuṭṭhissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhu udapādi
ud5.3:5.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparapaccayo satthu sāsane uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud5.3:6.2: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
ud5.3:6.3: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
ud5.3:6.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
ud5.3:7.1: atha kho suppabuddho kuṭṭhī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
ud5.3:7.2: atha kho acirapakkantaṃ suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ gāvī taruṇavacchā adhipātetvā jīvitā voropesi.
ud5.3:8.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekanantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
ud5.3:8.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
ud5.3:8.3: yo so bhante suppabuddho nāma kuṭṭhī bhagavato dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito so kālakato
ud5.3:9.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave suppabuddho kuṭṭhī paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi
ud5.3:9.2: suppabuddho bhikkhave kuṭṭhī tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
ud5.3:10.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud5.3:10.2: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena suppabuddho kuṭṭhī manussadaliddo ahosi
ud5.3:11.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave suppabuddho kuṭṭhī imasmiṃ yeva rājagahe seṭṭhiputto ahosi.
ud5.3:11.2: so uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto addasa tagarasikhiṃ paccekabuddhaṃ nagare piṇḍāya carantaṃ
ud5.3:11.6: so tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye pacittha
ud5.3:11.7: tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena imasmiṃ yeva rājagahe manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko
ud5.3:11.8: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādayi sīlaṃ samādayi sutaṃ samādayi cāgaṃ samādayi paññaṃ samādayi
ud5.3:11.9: so tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma saddhaṃ samādayitvā sīlaṃ samādayitvā sutaṃ samādayitvā cāgaṃ samādayitvā paññaṃ samādayitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ
ud5.3:11.10: so tattha aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cāti.
ud5.3:12.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
